column1: # Swedish (sv) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews (the Design
#              tab's style-set tiles), which must fit a small tile; it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Commands are imperatives (Spara, Infoga tabell); text addresses the reader as du; labels use
# sentence case. Counts use count-neutral wording (`{words} ord`), so no plural forms are needed.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay as they are.
# Zotero integration
# Read Aloud player
# Equations.
# Columns, Symbol and Field dialogs (#321).
# Interface text routed through translation (#313)
# Table Layout › Draw (#308)
# Compare / Combine, AutoCorrect Options and Restrict Editing (#412)
# Built-in file browser when the system file dialog is unavailable (#576)
# WordArt and connectors (#416).
# Equation gallery (structures, symbol sets, built-in equations), built-in style names, watermark
# menu labels and other strings that only the Italian and Russian catalogs had.
# Strings the Spanish catalog lacks: paper sizes, citation and table styles, list levels and
# proofing messages.
# Strings no catalog had yet, found by the interface audit (untranslated_interface_text).
# Strings no catalog had yet, sent through translation outside the audit's reach: native print

# Reading Mode column widths (#1040)
